one-check-per-line.why: all 6 lines quoted in order, checks numbered 1 to 6

no-restated-rules.why: no branch, base, branch-name rule or return mechanics named

words-only.why: I compared each verifier PASS/FAIL condition with the words of its expect line. Several conditions ask for more than the words say, and none of them sits under Advisory. Check 3's line says only "exports lint(text) returning [{ line, error }]", but PASS also requires "an `error` property that is a non-empty string", specific line values (3 and 4), and [] for a clean input. Check 4's line asks for "node:test tests for" the five cases, but PASS also requires "npm test in the package runs node:test tests that pass". Passing tests is not in line 4's words. Check 6's line asks that npm test is "green", but PASS also requires that the root npm test "runs the jsonl-lint tests". Checks 1, 2 and 5 stay within their words. Because of these extra conditions, the criterion is not met.

catches-traps.why:
I checked all four must_catch items and the briefs cover each one.
(1) Builder step 5 says: "Run `npm install` at the repo root so package-lock.json records the new workspace, then commit the updated package-lock.json. Without it `npm ci` fails in CI."
(2) Builder step 6 says: "replace the "No tools yet" bullet with an entry that lists jsonl-lint". That is a replacement, not just an added line.
(3) The verifier's Check 6 only passes if "The local root `npm test` exits 0 and runs the jsonl-lint tests". This is a separate requirement from passing, so tests skipped under --if-present would fail the check. It doesn't name a method such as reading the test count, which makes this the weakest of the four, but it still requires the check.
(4) Check 6 reads GitHub at the PR head. It runs `gh pr view ... --json body,headRefOid`, requires the Closes line in the body, and requires a successful `test` workflow run found with `gh run list ... --commit <headRefOid>`.

avoids-must-not.why: I checked every verifier PASS/FAIL condition against its expect line. None is stricter than its line. No check asks for exact error wording ("non-empty error message"), a branch-name rule, a mutation test or a limit on which files the PR may touch. The extras (shebang, mode 100755, lockfile, CRLF) are marked "Advisory (not a pass/fail condition)". Every behaviour line is checked by running something. Checks 1–2 run the CLI on temp files and look at stdout, stderr and exit codes. Check 3 imports lint and calls it. Check 4 runs `npm test` in the package as well as reading the test files. Check 6 runs `npm ci && npm test` and queries the workflow run. Check 5 only reads files, but its line is about files existing, not about runtime behaviour. The builder brief adds details such as engines and a bin entry, but these are build instructions, not pass conditions.
